summary.name: Default Folder X
summary.one_liner: A macOS utility that enhances Open and Save dialogs and the Finder with recent and favorite folders, hierarchical menus, and quick search.
keywords: rename duplicate delete files in dialog
use_cases: Quickly jump to frequently used folders when saving or opening files
Find recently used files and folders across apps
Set a default save folder for a specific application
Open or save into the current Finder window without navigating
Rename, duplicate, or delete files from within Open and Save dialogs
summary.what_it_does: Default Folder X adds enhancements to Open and Save dialogs in macOS applications, including hierarchical pop-up menus for recent, favorite, and open folders. It offers keyboard-driven quick search: pressing Command+Shift+Space opens a window to find files, folders, or applications by typing a few letters. It can also be used inside the Finder, with a customizable menu, a drawer for items, and a menu bar icon for moving files. Configurable keyboard shortcuts, remembered recent folders, and per-application default folders are included.
notable: Enhances Open and Save dialogs in all apps, plus the Finder
Command+Shift+Space Quick Search for files, folders and applications
Configurable keyboard shortcuts for favorite folders
Supports macOS 10.13 through 27, native on Intel and Apple Silicon
caveats: Page offers a free trial for 30 days, implying paid licensing after the trial
Page does not state full pricing details
